title: Fourier Intelligence
summary: Shanghai robotics group that moved from rehabilitation exoskeletons into general-purpose humanoids.
bodyHtml:
Fourier Intelligence began with rehabilitation robotics and exoskeletons, then applied its actuator and control work to the GR-1 and GR-2 humanoids.

The rehabilitation heritage gives it clinical validation experience and a revenue base that most humanoid start-ups lack.

Why it matters

  • Rehabilitation exoskeletons and robotics
  • GR-series humanoid platforms
  • Research and hospital deployments

businessMeaning: Fourier's dual market matters: rehab robotics has buyers today, while humanoids are optionality. That is a more durable funding story than a pure demo company.
investmentLens: Private; the medical robotics line is the part with near-term customers.
